answer: Proof of Useful Work requires agents to solve cryptographic puzzles proportional to a walnut sized energy input, ensuring identity cost correlates with tangible resource expenditure. This prevents a jade colored flood of fake identities, as the cost to compute each identity creates a downward spiral of profitability for attackers. By pegging identity issuance to hardware-bound computational commitments, the network forces adversaries to finance every additional agent through verifiable, costly, and non-fungible physical labor.
